warning.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P460e Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The AJ300 PHEV is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ300 PHEV V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ300 PHEV rebuild.

Because the Range Rover Sport P460e uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Range Rover Sport 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established AJ300 PHEV specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
